workers.name: Workspace files
workers.about: Writes or appends a file in the workspace and reads it back.

workers.name: Decision templates
workers.about: Runs a decision template’s dry runs before it is used.

workers.name: Browser
workers.about: Works through web pages in Nova’s own browser: opens, fills, clicks, signs in with a saved sign-in and reads, only on the hosts a task declares. You can watch, pause, stop or take over at any time; it asks for you at a step only a person may do. It never pays.

workers.name: Nova's chat model (node)
workers.about: Does scheduled work and helpers on its own, each in a conversation of its own, and hands the report to the conversation it is for.

workers.name: Model manager
workers.about: Downloads and removes local models through their runtime, and reads back what it got.

workers.name: Wake-on-LAN
workers.about: Wakes one of your compute devices with a Wake-on-LAN signal on its own network, and waits for its models to answer.

workers.name: Ingest screen
workers.about: Records outside content Nova blocked before any model read it, and why.

workers.name: Nova Computer
workers.about: Runs commands in Nova’s own workspaces: one container per project, with only that project’s folder, no network unless declared, and a checkpoint before every change so it can be undone.

health.detail: Not checked yet: it is checked when the computer is first used.

workers.name: Coding
workers.about: Makes a code change you asked for in chat: a coding agent writes it in a git worktree of Nova’s own, Nova runs the tests and a preview (asking first), and merges into your branch only when you confirm. It never pushes.

workers.name: Device mesh
workers.about: Records changes of hub: who is hub, at which epoch, under which roster.

workers.name: Checkpoints
workers.about: Records a restore to a checkpoint, with what it verified and what it carried over. On this machine only.

workers.name: Infrastructure
workers.about: Plans and applies infrastructure with OpenTofu in a project you registered: the plan runs by itself and changes nothing; Nova shows it to you in full, priced against the project’s budget, and applies it only when you confirm, after a checkpoint. A plan over budget, or one it can’t price, is never offered.

health.detail: OpenTofu isn’t on this computer; infrastructure runs can’t plan until it is.

workers.name: Network
workers.about: Changes a network target’s configuration you registered (a router, DNS, a firewall, a tailnet’s policy): it takes a snapshot and shows you the diff, applies only when you confirm, and puts the snapshot back by itself if Nova can’t hear from one of your devices within the window afterwards.

workers.name: The change pipeline
workers.about: Tries a change in a sandbox, tests it, releases it, and ships it through a canary or puts back what was there.

workers.name: The foundry
workers.about: Writes an extension for something you asked for (a rule pack, a template, a skill pack, a look), with its tests and probe, and proposes it as a change.

workers.name: Capture originals
workers.about: Brings one original capture from the device that holds it, when you ask, with your reason.

workers.name: Home Assistant
workers.about: Changes things in your home through Home Assistant when you ask, and reports what changed. Domains you mark confirm every time.

workers.name: Backups
workers.about: Makes the nightly backup and runs the restore drill, on this machine only.

workers.name: Hub promotion
workers.about: Records each step of a hub promotion, planned or from a backup, with what it found.
